headline: azamat1ch vaults from 1,867th to 33rd on ARC-2

sections.text: On the ARC-2 public board, the team azamat1ch gained 35.55 points in the past day, reaching 64.58 and moving from 1,867th to 33rd. It is the biggest single gain on the board today.
The team is still outside the gold places, so this is a move in the medal chase rather than a medal. Public standings stay provisional until the private board decides.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
